To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the spin–latticere-laxation and the spin–spin relaxation of 17 O-en-riched yttria stabilized zirconia samples depend sensitively on the oxygen ion mobility and that the motional displacements are characterized by relatively low activation energies.

the 17 O spin–lattice and spin–spin relaxation times of yttria-stablized zirconia are strongly temperature dependent, which is caused by the oxygen ion mobility, and that the activation energies for both relaxation times are of the same order of magnitude.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the oxygen ion mobility in the solid state.
a detailed analysis of the oxygen dynamics in yttrium-stabilized zircons and the underlying mechanisms.
the oxygen ion dynamics in YSZ and the underlying mechanisms are discussed.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the oxygen ions exhibit a rather high mobility in yttria-doped zirconia.
oxygen ion mobility in yttria-doped zirconia can be described as an activated process with a relatively small activation energy of about 30 kJ/mol.
the oxygen ions are mobile on a time scale of the order of 10 μs at temperatures above 400 K, and that the oxygen motions occur on length-scales which vary between about 0.5 and 1.0 nm.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
oxygen ion dynamics is a key factor for the NMR properties of yttria-stubilized zirconia, and that solid-state NMR spectroscopy is a powerful tool to study this ion dynamics.
17 O NQR spectroscopy is a very powerful tool for the study of oxygen ion dynamics in solid-state electrolytes, in particular for yttria-stabled zirconia.
the 17 O spin–lattice and spin–spin relaxation data can provide valuable information on the oxygen ion dynamics in yttriastabilized zirconias.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the dynamics of oxygen ions in yttria stabilized zirconia are much faster than previously thought, and that the dynamics are not restricted to the vicinity of the grain boundaries.
17 O NQR spectroscopy is a powerful tool to investigate the dynamics of oxygen ions in solid-state electrolytes.
17 O-enr. yttria-stab. zirconia can be used as a model system to investigate oxygen dynamics in solid electrolytes.
